up: Retrieve all compounds reported in document CHEMBL1629474. For each compound, return the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Sort the results by ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH doc_compounds AS (SELECT DISTINCT cr.molregno FROM compound_records cr JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1629474') SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM doc_compounds dc JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dc.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON dc.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY md.chembl_id
